name: magentofullstackdev/module-hyperion-checkout
description: Hyperion Checkout: Lit + Tailwind one-step checkout, cart page, and header minicart fragment endpoints. Ships the JS/CSS bundle built from the frontend/ workspace of the repository (view/frontend/web/.vite + view/frontend/web/assets/).

suggest.magento/module-paypal: PayPal Express Checkout smart buttons, Pay Later messages and the PayPal review page
suggest.magento/module-gift-message: Gift messages in the cart and on the order pages
suggest.magento/module-wishlist: Move to Wishlist on the cart page (reached by module name only)
suggest.magento/module-weee: Fixed product tax lines in the cart and the checkout (reached by module name only)
